title: Fantastic Experience
text:
A highlight of my Barcelona trip! 💍

Coralie was absolutely fantastic to work with! She was patient, knowledgeable, and fun, with clear instructions that made every step feel approachable. She explained how to use the tools and demonstrated the techniques, helping me understand what I was doing as I made my own silver ring.

She was also a wonderful host. She made us tea and created such a welcoming atmosphere that I felt completely comfortable.

title: Great creative small group activity with a wonderful teacher
text: Coralie was a great teacher.  We had a good balance of guidance and support with the space to choose our own designs and do all the hands-on making ourselves.  We each made different styles of rings to suit our preferences.  I really enjoyed trying out all the professional equipment under Coralie's guidance.  Tea and coffee were provided and I took along a little chocolate snack for when I was hungry.  Overall, a fabulous day, even better than I had hoped for.  And I love my ring, tailor-made just for me.  Thank you, Coralie.  We had a wonderful day.
author: Mia_N
